text:
maria: seeing a weird p99 bump on one of the fleet nodes, looks related to KV churn under bursty long-context traffic. p50 steady but p99 jumps from ~60ms to ~420ms for token gen.

maria: timeline: ramp test at 13:42 UTC, after ~2m of sustained 75 concurrent long-context requests we saw latency tail spike. memory on process climbed ~200MB over 10m.

maria: logs snippet: 
```
[2026-03-18T13:44:21Z] evicter: evict_rate=214/s pressure=high policy=fifo active_prefetch=1
[2026-03-18T13:44:21Z] runtime: batch_size=4 kernel=matmul_opt seq_len=320
[2026-03-18T13:44:22Z] kv: page_in=512 page_out=498 reuse_hits=62 reuse_misses=450
```

tom: curious — prefetch enabled? that page_in/page_out ratio looks like prefetch is pulling in entries then immediately evicting.

maria: yep kv.prefetch.enabled=true on that config. we also had kv.eviction.policy=fifo (we rolled that on 3 nodes last week for fairness experiment).

raj: suspicious. FIFO + prefetch under sustained backpressure can cause hotset oscillation. FIFO reinserts older entries at tail then prefetch keeps dragging in new entries -> churn. LRU would at least keep recent hot tokens.

olga: but note we saw memory growth too — if prefetch keeps creating transient entries for long contexts, the KV arena grows due to fragmentation even if reuse misses high. fragmentation + small slab allocations = slow GC reclaim.

maria: attached profiling (converted to short form): 
```
prof: wall 10s sample
- kv::page_in_handler 28%
- mem::alloc_small 18%
- scheduler::wait_io 12%
- runtime::emit_token 9%
```

maria: there's also an odd correlation with kernel selection: when matmul_opt picked for seq_len=320 we saw slightly larger batches which increase compaction pressure on KV due to higher concurrent KV windows. not sure if kernel timing shift nudges eviction timing.

tom: can you repro with a local harness? maybe run with prefetch off and fifo->lru swap. also capture pprof + jemalloc stats.

maria: repro steps I'm using: 
1) start node with kv.prefetch.enabled=true, kv.eviction.policy=fifo, long_context=true
2) run loadgen script: 
```
./loadgen --concurrency 75 --seq-len 300 --qps 120 --pattern long-tail.json
```
3) collect /debug/kv/stats and /metrics every 10s
```
```

raj: quick experiment idea: add a smoothing window on eviction_rate to inhibit prefetch when evict_rate > 100/s for 5s. cheap guard to break feedback loop. also consider adding a 'prefetch_budget' per-shard.

olga: agree. we should also test with kv.cooldown_ms parameter (try 500, 2000) to let reused entries settle. additionally enable jemalloc background purge to reduce fragmentation effects.

evict-bot: alert: node-42 evict_rate=237/s memory_growth=+210MB 2026-03-18T13:44:22Z

maria: thanks. action items: 
- tom to run controlled A/B (fifo vs lru) + prefetch toggles and post profiler (tom)
- raj to prototype eviction smoothing guard and prefetch_budget flag on branch (raj)
- olga to run fragmentation experiments with jemalloc tuning and kv.cooldown_ms sweep (olga)

tom: I'll run A/B on 3 instances this afternoon, will report p50/p95/p99 and attach pprof.

raj: prototype will be small patch — heuristic: if rolling_avg(evict_rate,5s) > 120 -> temporarily disable prefetch for that shard and emit metric kv.prefetch.suppressed=1. will open PR.

olga: I'll schedule a memory-profiling run with background purge and cooldown=2000ms. hoping to see less arena growth.

maria: thanks all. if anyone sees a quick win (guard + cooldown) we can push canary tomorrow. tagging @olga @tom @raj :thumbsup:

maria: last note - keep an eye on kernel selection flips in telemetry; they might be a secondary signal causing timing alignment across goroutines. if we can desync kernel selection a bit it might reduce synchronized eviction spikes.

tom: noted. will include kernel selection histogram in report.

maria: end.
